sn56.28:1.1: Cattārimāni bhikkhave ariyasaccāni || katamāni cattāri || || Dukkham ariyasaccaṃ || pe || dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ || || Sadevake bhikkhave loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya tathāgato ariyo || tasmā ariyasaccānī ti vuccanti || ||
sn56.28:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
